summary: Create an active OpenSpec change from docs/frontend-optimizer-diagnostics-spec.md to complete optimizer diagnostics UI coverage for failure samples, safe raw output handling, and optional model comparison results.
assumptions: Existing baseline optimizer diagnostics already cover model badges, baseline/best/test accuracy, kept/rejected state, accuracy delta, current eval link, failure analysis via analysis_text, and confusion matrix.
This change should focus on the remaining requirements from the clean diagnostics MD: failed case inspection, safe raw/long text handling, and optional model comparison results.
Backend diagnostic fields are optional; frontend implementation must tolerate missing failures and missing model comparison data.
Use failure_analysis when provided and fall back to existing analysis_text for compatibility.
Do not display secrets, authorization headers, API keys, tokens, passwords, or full raw prompt bodies by default.
